headline: Claude Code and Codex changed defaults this week, and Kilo Code's zod security fix means updating its VS Code extension.

themes.title: Defaults shift under you again
themes.facts: Codex turns memory v2 on for new profiles ([rust-v0.165.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.165.0)) and runs its Guardian classifier in conversation mode by default ([rust-v0.164.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.164.0)). Claude Code widens automatic model switches to custom model names ([2.1.312](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.312)).
themes.so_what: a setting that gave you one result last week may give another now, so check the new defaults before you rely on them.

themes.title: Security fixes and tighter sandboxes
themes.facts: Kilo Code upgrades zod in its VS Code extension to fix a memory-exhaustion advisory ([v7.8.20](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.20)). OpenCode's bundled Bun gets security fixes ([v1.19.4](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.19.4)), and Claude Code's sandboxed commands can no longer change the `--mcp-config` file ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)).
themes.so_what: update the tools that carry security fixes, and give sandboxed commands the explicit access they still need.

themes.title: Compaction gets fixes in two tools
themes.facts: Antigravity CLI 1.4.10 stops subagents from losing their task after compaction ([1.4.10](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.10)). Kilo Code fixes early auto-compaction ([v7.8.20](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.20)) and gives large-session compaction more output space ([v7.8.23](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.23)).
themes.so_what: long sessions are less likely to stall or lose their task, so restarting them is needed less often.

watch_next: Update Kilo Code to v7.8.20 or later, and approve Gmail, Docs, Drive and Cloud Console one by one in Antigravity CLI 1.4.9 if you use them through the agent. Kilo Code v7.8.22 shipped without notes, so its changes are not yet known.
